conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with an expected ~1.5%/month return. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Drawdowns are expected to be lower, but so is potential upside.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets risk-first growth with an expected ~2.5%/month return. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. This approach aims for moderate growth with controlled risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth with an expected ~4%/month return. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, increasing both potential upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs, and maintain strict stop discipline as losses can accumulate rapidly.

income.read: This income plan targets parking cash for yield with an expected ~1%/month return. It prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index funds. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
